verdict: Afterglow is held with real discipline: one typeface (Inter only, verified on every text node), ember used solely as light and the fluff squiggle, a wordmark with a genuine idea in its hooked h, and every heading at exactly two lines at 1440 and 390 with no horizontal scroll and 9.98 / 10.38 phone screens at 390 / 360. What keeps it under 9.5 is one brand-promise miss in the Try box, where the most archetypal launch-fluff line comes back 'Kept as written' with the brand's own banned words unmarked, plus a handful of small polish items.
to_95: Make the Try box deliver on 'The fluff goes' for the canonical launch line: 'Excited to announce that we are thrilled to launch our new seamless AI-powered dashboard' must not end as 'Kept as written' with an identical post card. At minimum mark 'seamless' and 'AI-powered' as fluff (your-call dotted marks are fine) and, when nothing is auto-cut, do not render an unchanged big post card under a 'Kept as written' label; show the marked words as the result and lead with the rewrite CTA.
Give the visitor a neutral avatar in the Try box and X preview instead of the Hookworthy h mark, so the brand mark never reads as the author of the visitor's own line.

Lift the grey second line of 'Say it at 11 PM. / Post it at 8:40 AM.' off the lit laptop screen (deepen the scrim behind the heading or shift the photo crop right) so the heading sits on clean dark at 1440.

issues.where: Try box ('Your facts stay. The fluff goes.'), 1440 and 390, pasting 'Excited to announce that we are thrilled to launch our new seamless AI-powered dashboard'
issues.problem: The headline promises the fluff goes, but the most recognisable fluff line a founder would paste returns 'Kept as written' and a large post card repeating the line unchanged. Only 'Excited to announce that' and 'thrilled to' are marked; 'seamless' and 'AI-powered' (words the brand itself bans) are not marked at all. The page's own Founder example strikes 'Excited to share that', so the demo looks inconsistent with itself and the brand personality (blunt, anti-fluff) goes soft at its key moment.
issues.fix: Mark 'seamless' and 'AI-powered' (and similar stock adjectives) as fluff with the dotted your-call style so the visitor can tap to cut them. When nothing is cut automatically, replace the unchanged big post card with a compact state: label 'Marked 4, your call', the line with marks, and the 'Get a rewrite in your voice, free' action as the primary pill. Never show an identical before/after under this headline.

issues.where: Try box editor, result card and 'Yours' X preview after typing your own line (You @you)
issues.problem: The visitor's avatar is the Hookworthy h mark, the same mark used for app notifications and the sheet. The logo ends up speaking the visitor's words, including clumsy ones, which blurs who the author is and dilutes the mark.
issues.fix: Use a neutral person glyph or a soft-white initial 'Y' disc on the #1A1B1E avatar ground for You; reserve the h mark for Hookworthy's own notifications and the sheet.

issues.where: Day cell heading 'Post it at 8:40 AM.' at 1440
issues.problem: The grey second line runs across the brightest part of the laptop-screen photo, so '8:40 AM.' loses contrast and the edge of the screen cuts through the digits. It is the only heading on the page not sitting on clean dark.
issues.fix: Add a left-to-right dark scrim under the heading block (about 70% #08090A fading out by 60% of the cell width) or move the photo's background-position about 12% right so the screen clears the heading.

issues.where: Nav and footer wordmark at 22px (1440 and 390)
issues.problem: The hook tail on the h opens a visibly wider gap before the first o than the very tight 'ookworthy' that follows, so at nav size it reads faintly as 'h ookworthy'. At the giant footer size it looks right.
issues.fix: In the small-size lockup only, pull the 'ookworthy' group about 0.02em left (or shorten the hook's terminal by roughly 8%) so the h-o counter matches the o-o spacing optically.

issues.problem: Secondary text uses about seven near-identical greys (#B4B8BE, #A9ADB1, #A4A8AF, #9A9A9A, #8D929A, #7D8288, #6C7179), excluding the platform-preview tones. Neighbouring captions sit one imperceptible step apart, which softens hierarchy rather than sharpening it.
issues.fix: Collapse the site ramp to three text greys (for example #A4A8AF body, #8D929A meta, #7D8288 faint) and keep the extra tones only inside the Threads/Bluesky/LinkedIn preview skins.

issues.where: Sticky full-width white 'Start free' bar at 390 and 360
issues.problem: The full-bleed white pill is the brightest object on every phone screen from the second screen to the footer, competing with the white pills inside the product moments (Put it back, Reply, Approve with my edit) and flattening the glass-and-ember mood.
issues.fix: Keep the bar but use the frosted pill style with a white label until the visitor passes the Try box, or cap it to a content-width pill (about 220px, centred) with the frosted backdrop behind it.
